Ada Estate.question: The suburb also includes some of the most advanced hospitals in Dar es Salaam, including the _____ (the only Tanzanian hospital specialized in cardiology)
Ada Estate.fact: The suburb also includes some of the most advanced hospitals in Dar es Salaam, including the Tanzania Heart Institute (the only Tanzanian hospital specialized in cardiology).
